bio: This wonderful castle estate, steeped in history and boasting superb grounds, now also accommodates not only a stylish spa hotel but also an appealing dining option. The elegant dining room boasts beautiful chandeliers, high ceilings and striking decorative porcelain displayed on shelves. When it comes to the classical French-style cuisine, choose between ambitious dishes à la carte or in the form of a tasting menu. They also serve a children's menu and event menus, eg Halloween or Christmas....
